Treat the headphone picture on the box as a flat photo cutout: retain its exact pictured perspective, color, contours, headband, metal arms, earcup shapes and interior openings. Constraints: faithful extraction of the device depiction already visible in the source only; no invented hardware details, text, packaging, person, hands or props.
